title: Ines and the Autopsy
author: Marguerite Amberdale
blurb: Theo Fairweather, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
